name: SH2 Cast - Dual (aimed)
description: MSCO_dual1-4 on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget AIMED cast resolved to DUAL. Dual is its own animation-type id and carries NO casting-source condition -- upstream's convention, kept (a dual cast leaves 0x835 at the left source). SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (0x815) == 10016 is cast_anim_ids.h kAimed.variant. The clips keep MSCO's MLh_SpellFire_Event; a dual cast arms both hands, so either hand's event commits it.
